metadata.description: Test-first workflow for coding agents, plus a Jev decision layer (model router, verbatim compaction, code review). lexi requires ponytail, caveman and jev.

plugins.name: lexi
plugins.description: Test-first flow without the spec ceremony. A PreToolUse hook keeps source edits behind a mirror test and protects existing assertions; /lexi:lexi drives one vertical slice at a time, red to green, calling /lexi:tdd for test quality and /lexi:grill for an open scope. Requires ponytail, caveman and jev, installed automatically; Jev stays off in a project until /lexi:init turns it on. Run /lexi:init once per project.

plugins.name: jev
plugins.description: Three-level decision layer on TypeSafe's Jev: picks model and effort per session and per subagent, compacts context without rewriting it, and gates code review with calibrated closed questions whose verdict is computed in code. Pairs with lexi: the review runs after the last GREEN. Needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY and Claude Code >= 2.1.276.

plugins.name: lexi-mods
plugins.description: Opt-in Claude Code mods for lexi: a colored usage row above the prompt (model, context, rate limits with reset, tokens, cost), the gate's last result in the status line and above the prompt, a toast when the lexi guard blocks an edit, and a pane of the session's subagents colored by type, each opening onto its tool-call timeline, answer, duration and tokens. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.
